description: This file is a shell script (.sh) used for managing software components and their installation, including cloning repositories, building with cmake and make, and deploying libraries and microservices related to a specific project environment.

methods.name: check_ret
methods.description: Checks the return code of the last command, copies log files on failure, and exits with the error code.

methods.name: exec_cmd
methods.description: Executes a command, redirects output to /dev/null, and handles failure by copying logs and exiting.

methods.name: exec_cmd_verbose
methods.description: Executes a command with verbose output, handling failure similarly.

methods.name: install_ms
methods.description: Installs a microservice library file into the designated directory.

methods.name: install_ms_plugin
methods.description: Installs a plugin into a subdirectory of the microservice directory.

methods.name: install_libbbf
methods.description: Builds and installs the libbbf library and associated binaries.

methods.name: install_libbbf_test
methods.description: Builds and installs the libbbf_test library.

methods.name: install_wifidmd_as_micro_service
methods.description: Clones, builds, and installs the wifidmd as a microservice.

methods.name: install_libeasy
methods.description: Clones, builds, and installs the libeasy library.

methods.name: install_libethernet
methods.description: Clones, builds, and installs the libethernet library.

methods.name: install_ethmngr_as_micro_service
methods.description: Clones, builds, and installs the ethmngr as a microservice.

methods.name: install_netmngr_as_micro_service
methods.description: Clones, builds, and installs the netmngr and related components as microservices.

methods.name: install_sysmngr_as_micro_service
methods.description: Clones, builds, and installs the sysmngr as a microservice, setting up configuration files.

methods.name: error_on_zero
methods.description: Checks a return value is not zero, copies logs, and exits if it is.

methods.name: check_valgrind_xml
methods.description: Runs valgrind with a specified command and generates a memory check report.

methods.name: generate_report
methods.description: Generates a JUnit report from input using tap-junit.

methods.name: install_cmph
methods.description: Clones and builds the cmph library for compile-time perfect hashing.
